data.regulation: MDR s.26  No sale or import of unlicensed devices
summaryList:
Risk 1:
The company imported, sold and/or offered for sale medical device(s) that were not authorised for sale by Health Canada.

Risk 2:
Labels on one or more medical devices available for sale in Canada did not set out the required information and/or the information was incorrect.

Risk 2:
The company did not provide a complete and/or accurate list of the names and/or addresses of the manufacturers of the medical devices that were being imported or distributed in Canada on its establishment licence application.

data.regulation: MDR s.45 (h.1) Incident reporting and/or provision of information in respect of serious risk of injury to human health
summaryList:
Risk 2:
The written procedure for the provision of information related to serious risk of injury to human health was inadequate.

data.regulation: MDR s.48  Notification with respect to change to 45(a),(b) in 15 days
summaryList:
Risk 2:
The company did not notify Health Canada within the required timeline that it had changed its name and/or address.

Risk 2:
The company did not adequately implement the written procedure for complaint handling.

Risk 2:
The written procedure for recalls was inadequate.
